senses.gloss:
कज् कज्, cl. 1. P. कजति, -जितुम्, to be
happy; to be confused with joy, pride or
sorrow; to grow, (in the last sense a Sautra root.)
कजिङ्ग कजिङ्ग, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

कज्जल कज्जल, अस्, m. (in the first sense
from कद्-जल), a cloud; (अम्), n. lampblack, con-
sidered as a collyrium and applied to the eyelashes
or eyelids medicinally or as an ornament, also sulphu-
ret of lead or antimony so used; (आ, ई), f. the fish
Cyprinus Atratus, or any kind peculiar to stagnant
waters, whence the name; (ई), f. sulphuret of mer-
cury, Æthiop's mineral; ink.
—कज्जल-ध्वज, अस्,
m. a lamp.
—कज्जल-रोचक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the
wooden stand or tripod on which a lamp is placed,
a candlestick.
—कज्जली-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
Tīrtha.
काजल का-जल, अम्, n. a little water.

कज्जलित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with lampblack or
with a collyrium prepared from it.

कज्ज्वल कज्ज्वल, अम्, n. lampblack, especially
considered as an application to the eyes; [cf. कज्जल.]
